WelcomeIntro: Taskitify shows the synced lyrics of the song playing in Spotify on your taskbar. Choose where the lyrics come from:
WelcomeLrclibBody: Lyrics from LRCLIB, a free and open lyrics database. No account or sign-in needed. Some songs have no lyrics there, and for others the timing may differ slightly from Spotify's.
WelcomeSpotifyBody: You sign in to your Spotify account in a separate window, right on Spotify's page. Taskitify then looks for Spotify's own lyrics first, the ones its app shows, and uses LRCLIB when Spotify has none.
WelcomeSpotifyPrivacy: Taskitify does not change anything in your Spotify account: the connection does not touch playlists, liked songs, history or settings, and plays nothing. It is used only to fetch lyrics. You type your password on Spotify's own page, and Taskitify never sees it. The sign-in is kept only on this computer, and disconnecting in the settings deletes it.
WelcomeSpotifyUnofficial: Experimental: it uses the Spotify web player's unofficial lyrics service, which may change or stop working. If it does, LRCLIB keeps working.
WelcomeChangeLater: You can change this later in the settings: notification area icon, or right-click the lyrics.
UnavailableLyrics: No synced lyrics are available for this song.
